extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and practitioners seeking to file a request to participate in the USPTO Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for filing a request to participate in the USPTO Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program, including filing method, document descriptions, fee information, and where to find detailed criteria and forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deciding Office
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office of Petitions is identified as the deciding office for requests to participate in the PPH pilot program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for request for participation
rubrics_metrics.description: The criteria for a request for participation in the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program is set forth via: Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) - Fast track examination of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed eligibility and substantive criteria are provided on the linked PPH page; applicants must consult that page to confirm they meet the program criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: General steps to file a PPH request
rubrics_metrics.description: In general, these are the steps to follow for filing a request for participation in the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program: (see linked PPH page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page references a step-by-step process on the linked PPH page. Follow the linked guidance for the procedural steps and required documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no fee required for the filing of request for participation in the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No filing fee is required for the PPH participation request.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to file (electronic filing and indexing)
rubrics_metrics.description: This petition, including any supporting documentation and any renewed request for participation, must be filed electronically via the Patent Electronic System and indexed with one of the following document descriptions: "Petition to make special under Patent Pros Hwy" or "Petition to make special under PCT-Patent Pros Hwy."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All petitions and any renewed requests must be submitted through the Patent Electronic System (PES). Use exactly one of the specified document descriptions when indexing the submission to ensure correct processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required petition contents
rubrics_metrics.description: The petition must include any supporting documentation and any renewed request for participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that all supporting documents and, if applicable, renewed requests are included in the electronic petition submission; details on what supporting documentation is required are on the linked PPH page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevant laws and rules
rubrics_metrics.description: For the relevant patent laws and rules applicable to request for participation in the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program, please see: Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) - Fast track examination of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should review the cited laws and rules on the linked page to understand statutory and regulatory authority, procedural limits, and compliance requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Various forms are available via: Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) - Fast track examination of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the forms provided on the linked page as applicable to prepare and submit the petition and supporting materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance / Contact
rubrics_metrics.description: For further assistance, please contact the Petitions Help Desk between 8:30 AM - 5 PM (EDT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the Petitions Help Desk during listed hours for questions about filing, required documentation, or other procedural issues related to PPH requests.
